# AT-18: js/wasm with the default loader behaves as upstream.
# go build -o p.wasm (loader default on) run through the tree's
# lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec gives the same stdout and exit as the
# upstream build run through upstream's exec. The same holds for logos build.

[!exec:node] skip 'node is required to run js/wasm binaries'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env UPROOT=/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/go/1.27.3/libexec

# Q3 pin: exactly oracle go1.27.3 against fork base go1.27.2.
exec $UPROOT/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.3 '
go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '

env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm

# Init order across three packages.
cd initorder
go build -o init.wasm .
exists init.loader.mjs
exec $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec init.wasm
stdout '(?m)^p1 init$'
stdout '(?m)^p2 init$'
stdout '(?m)^main init$'
stdout '(?m)^p1 p2\+p1 main main$'
! stdout '(?m)^rt$'
! stderr '(?m)^rt$'
cp stdout $WORK/init-our.txt
exec env GOROOT=$UPROOT $UPROOT/bin/go build -o init-up.wasm .
exec $UPROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec init-up.wasm
cp stdout $WORK/init-up.txt
cmp $WORK/init-our.txt $WORK/init-up.txt
logos build -o init-logos.wasm .
exists init-logos.loader.mjs
exec $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec init-logos.wasm
! stdout '(?m)^rt$'
! stderr '(?m)^rt$'
cp stdout $WORK/init-logos.txt
cmp $WORK/init-logos.txt $WORK/init-up.txt
cd ..

# Goroutine ping-pong over unbuffered channels.
cd pingpong
go build -o pong.wasm .
exec $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec pong.wasm
stdout '(?m)^1000$'
cp stdout $WORK/pong-our.txt
exec env GOROOT=$UPROOT $UPROOT/bin/go build -o pong-up.wasm .
exec $UPROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec pong-up.wasm
cp stdout $WORK/pong-up.txt
cmp $WORK/pong-our.txt $WORK/pong-up.txt
logos build -o pong-logos.wasm .
exec $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec pong-logos.wasm
cp stdout $WORK/pong-logos.txt
cmp $WORK/pong-logos.txt $WORK/pong-up.txt
cd ..

# Unrecovered panic: nonzero exit with the upstream header.
cd panicexit
go build -o panic.wasm .
! exec $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec panic.wasm
stderr 'panic: boom-wasm'
! stdout .
exec env GOROOT=$UPROOT $UPROOT/bin/go build -o panic-up.wasm .
! exec $UPROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec panic-up.wasm
stderr 'panic: boom-wasm'
! stdout .
logos build -o panic-logos.wasm .
! exec $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec panic-logos.wasm
stderr 'panic: boom-wasm'
! stdout .
cd ..

# os.Exit(3): same stdout and exact exit code on every build.
cd exitcode
go build -o exit.wasm .
! exec $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec exit.wasm
stdout '(?m)^before-exit$'
cp stdout $WORK/exit-our.txt
exec env GOROOT=$UPROOT $UPROOT/bin/go build -o exit-up.wasm .
! exec $UPROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec exit-up.wasm
stdout '(?m)^before-exit$'
cp stdout $WORK/exit-up.txt
cmp $WORK/exit-our.txt $WORK/exit-up.txt
logos build -o exit-logos.wasm .
! exec $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec exit-logos.wasm
stdout '(?m)^before-exit$'
cp stdout $WORK/exit-logos.txt
cmp $WORK/exit-logos.txt $WORK/exit-up.txt
[!GOOS:windows] exec sh -c '$GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec exit.wasm; echo exit=$?'
[!GOOS:windows] stdout '(?m)^exit=3$'
[!GOOS:windows] exec sh -c '$UPROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec exit-up.wasm; echo exit=$?'
[!GOOS:windows] stdout '(?m)^exit=3$'
[!GOOS:windows] exec sh -c '$GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec exit-logos.wasm; echo exit=$?'
[!GOOS:windows] stdout '(?m)^exit=3$'
cd ..

# syscall/js calls.
cd jsvalue
go build -o js.wasm .
exec $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec js.wasm
stdout '(?m)^42$'
stdout '(?m)^hi-wasm$'
stdout '(?m)^9007199254740991$'
cp stdout $WORK/js-our.txt
exec env GOROOT=$UPROOT $UPROOT/bin/go build -o js-up.wasm .
exec $UPROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec js-up.wasm
cp stdout $WORK/js-up.txt
cmp $WORK/js-our.txt $WORK/js-up.txt
logos build -o js-logos.wasm .
exec $GOROOT/lib/wasm/go_js_wasm_exec js-logos.wasm
cp stdout $WORK/js-logos.txt
cmp $WORK/js-logos.txt $WORK/js-up.txt
cd ..

-- initorder/go.mod --
module example.com/initorder

go 1.27

-- initorder/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/initorder/p1"
	"example.com/initorder/p2"
)

func init() {
	fmt.Println("main init")
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(p1.Name(), p2.Both(), "main main")
}

-- initorder/p1/p1.go --
package p1

import "fmt"

func init() {
	fmt.Println("p1 init")
}

func Name() string {
	return "p1"
}

-- initorder/p2/p2.go --
package p2

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/initorder/p1"
)

func init() {
	fmt.Println("p2 init")
}

func Both() string {
	return "p2+" + p1.Name()
}

-- pingpong/go.mod --
module example.com/pingpong

go 1.27

-- pingpong/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	c1 := make(chan int)
	c2 := make(chan int)
	go func() {
		for i := 0; i < 1000; i++ {
			v := <-c1
			c2 <- v + 1
		}
	}()
	v := 0
	for i := 0; i < 1000; i++ {
		c1 <- v
		v = <-c2
	}
	fmt.Println(v)
}

-- panicexit/go.mod --
module example.com/panicexit

go 1.27

-- panicexit/main.go --
package main

func main() {
	panic("boom-wasm")
}

-- exitcode/go.mod --
module example.com/exitcode

go 1.27

-- exitcode/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("before-exit")
	os.Exit(3)
}

-- jsvalue/go.mod --
module example.com/jsvalue

go 1.27

-- jsvalue/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"syscall/js"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(js.ValueOf(21 * 2).Int())
	fmt.Println(js.ValueOf("hi-wasm").String())
	fmt.Println(js.Global().Get("Number").Get("MAX_SAFE_INTEGER").Int())
}
